name: Meta Project
description: Systematic review and Meta-analysis project template with PRISMA-oriented numbered workflow folders: literature review/topic selection, protocol, search/dedupe, title/abstract screening, full-text review, data extraction, quality assessment, data analysis, result figures, manuscript submission, and presentation outputs. New projects use the meta-v2 folder schema and must not create generic Experiment/analysis Meta outputs, Survey/meta-analysis, or a meta-analysis subfolder.

metaFields.label: Target venue
metaFields.placeholder: Journal, preprint, thesis, or internal report

metaFields.label: Review type
metaFields.placeholder: diagnostic | intervention | prognostic | prevalence | network | scoping

metaFields.label: Registration / protocol reference
metaFields.placeholder: Optional: PROSPERO / OSF / protocol DOI. If unavailable, write registration guidance only.

literature.label: Evidence scope
literature.placeholder: Databases, years, languages, study designs, topic boundary

literature.label: Search plan
literature.placeholder: PubMed/MEDLINE strategy, optional sources, citation chasing, registry checks

literature.label: Seed references
literature.placeholder: One seed paper, guideline, or prior review per line

literature.label: Evidence gap
literature.placeholder: Why this review is needed and what uncertainty it resolves

literature.label: Meta topic selection
literature.placeholder: Scientific relevance, evidence volume, heterogeneity risk, extractable effect sizes, and submission value

literature.label: Scoping / systematic review route
literature.placeholder: Whether this should remain scoping/narrative/systematic review or proceed to quantitative Meta-analysis

ideation.label: Review objective
ideation.placeholder: Primary objective and intended decision value

ideation.label: Eligibility criteria
ideation.placeholder: Inclusion and exclusion criteria for screening

ideation.label: Protocol plan
ideation.placeholder: Protocol decisions, PRISMA logic, AI first/second-screen gates, and explicit user override handling

experiment.label: Screening plan
experiment.placeholder: AI pre-screen scoring, Claude second-pass review, optional catch-up audit, full-text gates, final decisions, conflict handling

experiment.label: Full-text / parse plan
experiment.placeholder: Legal full-text sources for explicit fulltext_manifest needs_full_text queue records, PDF/Markdown/HTML/text assets, MinerU or direct conversion, parse-quality triage

experiment.label: Extraction / quality plan
experiment.placeholder: Candidate extraction fields, evidence links, confidence, user authorization or agent review, RoB/QUADAS/NOS/GRADE plan

experiment.label: Synthesis plan
experiment.placeholder: Effect measure, model, heterogeneity, subgroup/sensitivity, bias checks

publication.label: PRISMA manuscript outline
publication.placeholder: Abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, limitations, conclusion

publication.label: Figures / tables plan
publication.placeholder: PRISMA flow, study characteristics, RoB, forest, funnel, evidence certainty

publication.label: Submission checklist
publication.placeholder: PRISMA checklist, supplements, data availability, conflicts, funding

promotion.label: Slide outline
promotion.placeholder: Question, methods, PRISMA flow, evidence profile, main result, limitations

promotion.label: Public summary plan
promotion.placeholder: Plain-language summary and artifact links, if needed

promotion.label: Delivery assets
promotion.placeholder: Slides, homepage, audio, video, poster, or journal club package

quality_gate: The review question is specific enough for reproducible search
Search scope and seed references are recorded
Literature review, topic selection, and scoping route artifacts use 00_literature/ before protocol files are created
Project startup and pipeline bootstrap reports, when produced, are saved under 01_protocol/project_startup_report.md or a timestamped variant.
If evidence is insufficient for the requested route, write a feasibility or no-data report instead of inventing records.

task_blueprints.title: Run literature review, topic selection, and scoping route check
task_blueprints.description: Create evidence-gap rationale, seed references, candidate review question, Meta topic feasibility notes, and scoping/systematic review route decisions under 00_literature/. Do not write locked protocol files yet.

task_blueprints.title: Prepare search records and dedupe plan
task_blueprints.description: Convert the selected question into formal search exports, import logs, and dedupe rules under 02_search_dedupe/ without creating Survey/meta-analysis or meta-analysis subfolders.

quality_gate: PICO/PECO and eligibility criteria are operational for AI first/second screening and explicit user overrides
Protocol decisions identify the review type and synthesis family
Protocol artifacts use 01_protocol/
Project startup and task-queue reports are saved under 01_protocol/project_startup_report.md or a timestamped variant.
Human review confirms protocol lock, PICO/PECO, eligibility criteria, and review type before search/screening automation proceeds.

task_blueprints.title: Write Meta project startup report and skill-routed task queue
task_blueprints.description: Use meta-pipeline-planner first and meta-analysis-workflow for cross-stage orchestration. Summarize current stage, missing artifacts, selected or pending review type, human review gates, and the skill list for each automatic step. Save the startup or task-queue report under 01_protocol/project_startup_report.md or a timestamped variant.

task_blueprints.title: Lock protocol, PICO/PECO, and eligibility criteria
task_blueprints.description: Write protocol drafts, review-type rationale, PICO/PECO, outcomes, and inclusion/exclusion criteria under 01_protocol/.

task_blueprints.title: Decide scoping / systematic review route
task_blueprints.description: If the project is a scoping or non-quantitative systematic review, keep route rationale and evidence mapping design under 00_literature/scoping_review/, then plan PRISMA counts and narrative synthesis under 01_protocol/, 03_title_abstract_screening/, 04_full_text_review/, and 09_manuscript_submission/ without forcing statistical pooling.

quality_gate: Search strategy, raw exports, import logs, and dedupe decisions are reproducible
All search and dedupe artifacts use 02_search_dedupe/
Do not create Survey/meta-analysis or meta-analysis subfolders
Human review or explicit signoff checks final search/dedupe input before screening.
If no usable search data or imports exist, write 02_search_dedupe/no_data_report.md instead of inventing records.
Any search normalization code is stored under 02_search_dedupe/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Prepare search records and dedupe plan
task_blueprints.description: Convert the selected question into formal search exports, import logs, and dedupe rules under 02_search_dedupe/ without creating Survey/meta-analysis or meta-analysis subfolders.

quality_gate: Title/abstract screening has first-screen and second-screen passes after search/dedupe: audit files go under 03_title_abstract_screening/01_ai_pre_screen/ and 03_title_abstract_screening/02_agent_rescreen/, with synchronized stage=title_abstract decisions in 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json
Named-agent-reviewed title/abstract include/maybe records, plus explicit user overrides, are eligible for a missing-full-text queue; two human reviewers are not required
Markdown is explanatory only; screening_decisions.json is the synchronization source
Low-confidence or conflicting screening decisions are collected for targeted human review, not a broad default user backlog.

task_blueprints.title: Run title/abstract first and second screening
task_blueprints.description: After search/dedupe, use AI for title/abstract first-screen include/exclude/maybe recommendations, then run a named Claude second-screen reviewer. Use explicit user decisions only as overrides or spot checks, not a routine final gate. Write first-screen audit files under 03_title_abstract_screening/01_ai_pre_screen/ and second-screen queues, reports, decisions, and conflicts under 03_title_abstract_screening/02_agent_rescreen/. Also write/update 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json using schemaVersion meta-screening-v1 and stage=title_abstract so the intelligent screening page can sync the records; Markdown is explanatory only.

quality_gate: Run lawful full-text download/acquisition first for queued records, using existing project assets, user uploads, PMC/OA, and other documented public sources; only remaining incomplete records should proceed to Zotero handoff
Only incomplete records written to fulltext_manifest.json/csv with needs_full_text=true are pushed to Zotero

Full-text screening repeats the same first-screen and second-screen passes after Zotero attachments are synced back: write synchronized stage=full_text decisions in 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json, and keep full-text assets, parse outputs, unavailable lists, and concise audit logs under 04_full_text_review/ or 04_full_text_review/fulltext/ without creating 01_ai_pre_screen/ or 02_agent_rescreen/ subfolders
Missing full text is pushed to Zotero for PDF retrieval/attachment; do not run broad in-app web downloads or generate large manual import files
MinerU parsing outputs include parse-quality flags and escalates only low-quality or conflicted records for user confirmation
If a lawful PDF/full text cannot be located or parsed, write 04_full_text_review/unavailable_full_text_report.md and keep the record blocked instead of inventing text.
Human review checks full-text license/availability and parse quality before extraction proceeds.
Any download, parse, or sync code is stored under 04_full_text_review/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Download lawful full text, hand remaining missing items to Zotero, then run full-text screening
task_blueprints.description: Use title/abstract Claude-reviewed include/maybe records plus explicit user overrides only as eligibility, then write only incomplete records to fulltext_manifest.json/csv with needs_full_text=true. First run lawful full-text download/acquisition with existing project assets, user uploads, PMC/OA, and other documented public sources; record downloaded/exists/manual_upload_required/no_oa_pdf/failed status. Then push only records that are still incomplete to Zotero for PDF retrieval/attachment. After Zotero attachments are synced back, repeat first-screen/second-screen review for full text. Write/update 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json with stage=full_text, and keep full-text screening audit logs, Zotero handoff/sync status, unavailable full text, MinerU/direct-conversion outputs, parse-quality flags, and issues requiring re-read under 04_full_text_review/ or 04_full_text_review/fulltext/ without creating 01_ai_pre_screen/ or 02_agent_rescreen/ subfolders.

quality_gate: Extraction rows preserve source evidence, page/table provenance, confidence, parse-quality caveats, and review status
Candidate rows must be user-authorized or confirmed before final statistics
If required fields cannot be extracted from source evidence, write 05_data_extraction/cannot_extract_data_report.md instead of filling values from assumptions.
Human review confirms extraction rows before final statistics.
Any extraction code is stored under 05_data_extraction/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Build data extraction tables
task_blueprints.description: Create candidate study characteristics, outcome fields, effect-size fields, and meta-ready extraction datasets under 05_data_extraction/ with source evidence, confidence, parse-quality caveats, and review status. Candidate rows must be user-authorized or confirmed before final statistics.

quality_gate: Quality appraisal uses the review-type appropriate tool: RoB, QUADAS, NOS, GRADE, or an explicitly justified alternative
Quality and risk-of-bias outputs preserve source evidence, confidence, and review status
Human review checks quality/risk-of-bias judgments before statistics.
Any quality assessment code is stored under 06_quality_assessment/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Complete quality and risk-of-bias assessment
task_blueprints.description: Choose the appropriate RoB/QUADAS/NOS/GRADE route for the review type and write quality appraisal tables, evidence notes, and Claude review flags under 06_quality_assessment/.

quality_gate: Only user-authorized or confirmed extraction rows can feed 07_data_analysis/
Synthesis route matches the review type and available effect fields
Statistical scripts, model inputs, diagnostics, and machine-readable outputs are saved under 07_data_analysis/
If synthesis eligibility is not met, write 07_data_analysis/cannot_synthesize_report.md instead of forcing a model.
Human review confirms statistical inputs and synthesis route before manuscript claims are written.
Any statistical code is stored under 07_data_analysis/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Gate synthesis and run data analysis
task_blueprints.description: First check that included studies, effect fields, variance or convertible data, heterogeneity sources, quality appraisal, full-text/parse authorization, and extraction rows are user-authorized or confirmed. Then route diagnostic, intervention/effect-size, prognostic HR, prevalence/single-arm, or network Meta planning with the appropriate skills. Save scripts and outputs to 07_data_analysis/ and result figures/tables to 08_results_figures/.

quality_gate: Result figures and tables are under 08_results_figures/
Figure legends and table notes match extraction, quality appraisal, and analysis outputs
PRISMA flow counts are consistent with search, screening, and full-text decisions
Human review checks figures, legends, and PRISMA counts against source artifacts before manuscript integration.
Any plotting code is stored under 08_results_figures/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Generate result figures and tables
task_blueprints.description: Create PRISMA flow, study characteristics, quality/risk-of-bias summaries, forest/funnel/SROC or route-appropriate result figures, table notes, and export-ready legends under 08_results_figures/.

quality_gate: PRISMA manuscript and supplementary files are under 09_manuscript_submission/
Claims match the included studies, extraction table, and synthesis outputs
Reporting checklist and search appendix are complete
Human review checks PRISMA compliance, references, and data availability before submission files are finalized.
Any manuscript automation code is stored under 09_manuscript_submission/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Draft PRISMA manuscript and submission package
task_blueprints.description: Write manuscript sections, abstract, PRISMA checklist, search appendix, supplements, and data availability files to 09_manuscript_submission/; reuse result figures/tables from 08_results_figures/.

task_blueprints.title: Audit PRISMA compliance and reproducibility
task_blueprints.description: Check search logs, PRISMA counts, extraction sheets, statistics, figures, references, supplements, and data availability.

quality_gate: Presentation claims do not exceed the certainty of evidence
Slides, homepage, audio, and video use 10_presentation/
Human review checks public-facing claims against evidence certainty before release.
Any presentation or homepage code is stored under 10_presentation/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Build Meta project presentation storyline
task_blueprints.description: Create slide flow covering question, methods, PRISMA flow, evidence profile, pooled effects, limitations, and implications under 10_presentation/.

task_blueprints.title: Prepare promotion and delivery assets
task_blueprints.description: Package slides, homepage copy, optional audio, optional video, and handoff notes into 10_presentation/.
